When you call them, they feign ignorance and even have the gall to ask you if you have a weighing machine!! Utter cheats! Zomato should be blacklisting them.

At the time of payment don't know why Sodexo food card was not getting accepted. Generally it should.
Overall good icecream experience.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing. Very good place to try something unique in terms of Gola. Their Malai gola is very tasty. One of the best place for icecream in Ghatkopar khau galli.

featured_reviews.name: suraj pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the malai gola here and it was very disappointing. The taste was very weird and everything felt badly mixed together. It did not taste fresh or good at all. I would not recommend the malai gola from this shop. Better to drink juice from some other shop nearby.

featured_reviews.name: DreamFoodie
featured_reviews.review_text:

Must try
Bashshahi malai gola also called as rajwadi gola (chocolate flavour)
Dry fruit gola my personal favourite
Or plain kala khatta

This is one of the best malai gola centres in Mumbai and is definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Deval Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: It is the famous golawala in Ghatkopar khaugali. Malaigola is famous and we tried that. They use a lot of malai and rabdi in preparation for it. We enjoyed the taste of Malai gola. We will try other gola and might update the review.

featured_reviews.name: Anchal Garg
featured_reviews.review_text:
Such unique concept of Gola. On a hot summer day if you are craving something khatta meetha then definitely try the Sada Gola.
If you want to try something different from the usual, then must try would be the Malai Gola.
Loaded with loads of malai and dry fruits, this one is super filling and tasty 😋

featured_reviews.review_text: I loved the malai gola alot. Its really unique in its taste. And this place is in khaugalli whwre you find varitet of vegetarian food. You just end up eating Every damn thing.
